1.consolidated_definition: Árbol silvestre de mediana altura, de tronco fino con la corteza áspera y rosada, y de hojas apiñadas; su madera se emplea para hacer muebles. Euphorbiaceae; Croton lucidum.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Wild tree of medium height, with a slender trunk having rough and pinkish bark, and clustered leaves; its wood is used to make furniture. Euphorbiaceae; Croton lucidum.
